backend_scope.also_read: Complete command/action/node struct layouts, completion macro binding, state constructors, step/frame assertions, actual caller and native/CBMC entry definitions.

findings.location: CONCRETE_MAIN native branch: before/issued strtoull conversions and step selector strtoul conversion
findings.problem: The native parser passes a null end pointer, omits errno/range checks and narrows values before validating their destination domain. Invalid decimal suffixes are accepted as numeric prefixes, uint32_t payloads can be truncated, and a too-wide selector can narrow into0..3. The success output records only call count. A future observer cannot infer exact requested full-u32 argument identity from this CLI/result alone.
findings.required_repair: Keep V1 frozen. Add a narrow canonical decimal full-token parser with checked range before casts and deterministic malformed/overflow controls, or establish an independently reviewed exact external argv/value boundary. Rebind any future native producer/result identity to that repair. No actual native run is needed to establish this source issue.
findings.science_impact: Symbolic CBMC full-width nondeterministic inputs and WP source relation are unaffected. Native replay readiness is held.
static_examples: before="7junk" is not checked as a complete token
before="4294967296" is converted directly to uint32_t without a pre-narrowing range check
selector is converted to unsigned before selector>3 is checked; an oversized value can narrow into the valid domain

limits: This is a source/preparation review, not an actual one-step or WP proof.
Actual complete CBMC/WP/native outputs, consistency controls, same-entry typed context/constructed receiver authority, and dedicated public partial-summary admission remain pending.
No source/API declaration of the logical readiness query, no original-header call correspondence and no fairness/termination/resource completeness are inferred.
positive_scope: One fixed constructed command/action/cell/four-constant-node relation is explicit; it is not arbitrary backend-state authority or original C++/hardware correspondence.

Pending zero preserves memory/event/action state; pending one runs the original query→wait→command cover→node cover→action completion→device write path; completed state stutters and returns ready without another draw. Full uint32 before/issued values enter symbolic targets.

One-step assertions separately cover answer, pending, visible value, event count, action completion, draw count and the concrete topology/value frame. There is no hidden bounded prefix used as an unbounded proof.

The unchanged polling caller has a source-exact quotient version after only removal of the literal loop annotation. Its invariant/frame and terminates-false contract express partial correctness; the helper choice admits arbitrary zero runs and neither fairness nor eventual-one is assumed.

The negative zero-read caller invokes the same concrete/quotient observation preconditions; original model assertions and future ordinary/RTE/init/frame/smoke requirements remain pending and unfiltered.

Producer and tests are small isolated source-generation seams; full backend hashes, generated inputs, function closures, separate symbolic/native branches and false acceptance metadata avoid helper-name proof credit.
